text-align: center; white-space: break-spaces; display: table; overflow-wrap: break-word; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; width: 120px;

span.p:
POLYMORPHISM: waitingPenalty() is abstract and
chooseItem() / billFor() can be overridden.
Restaurant and GameController call them with no
type checks, so VIP and Critic only add subclasses.

div.style: text-align: center; white-space: break-spaces; display: table; overflow-wrap: break-word; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; width: 120px;

span.p:
VIP: loses 5 per waiting turn and pays 10% off.
Overrides waitingPenalty() and billFor().

div.style: text-align: center; white-space: break-spaces; display: table; overflow-wrap: break-word; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; width: 120px;

span.p:
Critic: loses 12 per waiting turn and always orders
the most expensive menu item (documented rule).
Overrides waitingPenalty() and chooseItem().

div.style: text-align: center; white-space: break-spaces; display: table; overflow-wrap: break-word; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; width: 120px;

span.p:
Only place that knows the concrete customer types.
Stage 2 change: a setup change, not a rule change.

div.style: text-align: center; white-space: break-spaces; display: table; overflow-wrap: break-word; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; width: 120px;

span.p:
COMPOSITION: Restaurant creates and owns its
Tables and ScoreBoard.
waitingQueue is a subset of customers.
ENCAPSULATION: Restaurant coordinates changes to the
queue, tables and orders; each class validates its own
state transitions. The bill is computed once in
placeOrder() and fixed in the Order.

div.style: text-align: center; white-space: break-spaces; display: table; overflow-wrap: break-word; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; width: 120px;

span.p:
One task per turn: consumeTask() is called
only when the ActionResult is a success.

div.style: text-align: center; white-space: break-spaces; display: table; overflow-wrap: break-word; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; width: 120px;

span.p:
Order and Menu depend on the interface,
so a Stage 3 ComboMeal plugs in unchanged.
